name: agent-office
description: A live 3D mission control for coding agents

scripts.check:server: node --check server/index.mjs && node --check server/agents.mjs && node --check bin/agent-office.mjs && node --check vscode-extension/extension.cjs
scripts.test:behavior: node --test scripts/test-agent-behavior.mjs scripts/test-providers.mjs scripts/test-cli.mjs scripts/test-vscode.mjs scripts/test-office-layout.mjs scripts/test-roster-api.mjs
scripts.package:vscode: node scripts/prepare-vscode-package.mjs && cd vscode-extension && npm exec --yes --package=@vscode/vsce -- vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../work/agent-office-vscode.vsix
scripts.verify:public: npm run check:public && npm run lint && npm run test:behavior && npm run build && npm run check:server
